# Kordran - full summary for language models

Source: https://kordran.com/
Entity: Kordran Inc.
Contact: contact@kordran.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kordran
X: https://x.com/kordran_

## Positioning

Kordran helps industrial manufacturers verify supplier pricing, resolve purchasing-cost discrepancies, and prevent recurring charges.

The public offer is supplier cost intelligence and execution: investigation of purchasing prices, contract discrepancies, surcharges, and supplier price increases, followed by commercial work to resolve supported issues.

Kordran does not advertise lending, inventory financing, private credit, or investment services.

Working principle:
- Find the cost.
- Recover the value.
- Fix the system.

## What Kordran handles

- Price discrepancies: billed prices that differ from agreed terms.
- Supplier increases: new prices that need commercial review.
- Persistent surcharges: charges that continue after terms change.

Not every discrepancy is misconduct or a recoverable overpayment.

## Method

1. Verify. Reconcile pricing records, agreements, and purchasing history to establish what the evidence supports.
2. Resolve. Work with the customer's team to pursue supported corrections and resolve supplier disputes.
3. Prevent. Help implement controls that reduce repeat discrepancies.

Kordran remains involved after the analysis, through an approved corrective action. Engagements are established by a separate written agreement.

## Illustrative example

The homepage shows a hypothetical supplier price discrepancy. It is labeled as an illustrative example and is not a customer result.

- Agreed unit price: $42
- Billed unit price: $44
- Units reviewed: 18,000
- Potential discrepancy: $36,000
- Formula: 18,000 × ($44 − $42) = $36,000

A pricing difference is a finding, not yet a recovery. Kordran reviews the relevant agreement, validates eligible transactions, and works toward an authorized commercial correction.

## Who it is for

Manufacturers managing multiple suppliers, changing prices, and purchasing records spread across systems. Relevant environments include industrial equipment, electromechanical assemblies, and precision manufactured components. These are target environments, not a list of customers.

A first conversation can start with one supplier: a price increase, disputed charge, or purchasing discrepancy. Useful inputs are a supplier quotation or price notice, previous pricing, and a relevant agreement or purchasing record.

## Contact

Qualified visitors can start a conversation at https://kordran.com/#contact or email contact@kordran.com.

The public form asks for name, company, work email, and a brief description of the issue. It asks people not to include contracts, invoices, or pricing files. Submitted information is reviewed to determine whether Kordran is a fit.

## Important limits

Kordran Inc. is not a law firm, customs broker, lender, or regulated financial institution. The site does not state client counts, savings, recovered amounts, years of operation, certifications, or guaranteed turnaround times. Nothing on the site is a guarantee of outcomes.
